title: substitute the absolute worktree path for DIR in Check lines before running them, so a spec placeholder does not fail a round

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261128-002830-34c6cdfa, project ork, item S648:

substitute the absolute worktree path for DIR in Check lines before running them, so a spec placeholder does not fail a round

Evidence: round 1 slice check failed with "go: chdir DIR: no such file or directory" and needed a fix round that only edited the spec
